title: Signature Spectral peak picking — Audio Fingerprint Search
description: Signature original — Fingerprinting starts from a spectrogram: time on one axis, frequency on the other, energy as brightness. Peak picking keeps only local energy maxima, the 'constellation' of the recording. Peaks survive compression and background noise far better than raw waveforms. title: Signature Peak-pair hashing — Audio Fingerprint Search
description: Signature original — Each fingerprint hash combines two peaks: their frequencies and the time between them. Pairing makes hashes translation-invariant in time: a clip starting anywhere still matches. The fanout parameter bounds how many partners each peak pairs with, controlling hash count. title: Signature Time-offset voting — Audio Fingerprint Search
description: Signature original — Matching hashes vote for the time offset between query and reference; the true song accumulates a sharp peak. Random collisions scatter votes uniformly, so the offset histogram separates signal from noise. This is how a 10-second phone recording identifies a song in a million-track catalog.
